lede: The biggest decision this week lands in Mountain Village on Wednesday the 15th, where Town Council takes up second reading of an ordinance that would change how MVHA fees are set — shifting from hardcoded figures to an annual schedule — alongside a resolution adopting the actual 2027 fee amounts for Village Court and other workforce housing. Elsewhere, Telluride's Town Council spends three hours Monday grinding through the 2027 budget covering enterprise funds, open space, and affordable housing — no votes yet, but the numbers being shaped now will matter. Ouray County commissioners meet Tuesday on a Prop 123 affordable housing commitment and a new law enforcement intergovernmental agreement, while the Telluride Horror Show kicks off Friday at the Sheridan Opera House.
